**Finding: Compliant** (rule LD — Liquidated damages and penalties payable by Customer)

The agreement contains no Customer-payable liquidated damages, penalties, late-payment interest, accelerated fee or early-termination/minimum fee:

- **§ 11 (p0084)** obliges Sparkling only to pay the fees set out in the Fee Schedule.
- **§ 17(b) (p0118)** gives Sparkling termination for convenience on 90 days' notice with no exit payment or stipulated sum.
- **§ 17 (p0128)** runs in our favour: on Garman's default the licence converts to perpetual, fee-free, and Garman refunds fees for services not rendered.
- **§ 15** caps both parties to direct damages; **§ 19** non-solicitation is mutual with no stipulated payment.

This satisfies the preferred position (no liquidated damages or penalties payable by Customer), so no redline was proposed.
